text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey... Hey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A familiar voice pulls me back to
consciousness.
As I open my eyes, I
slowly adjust to the blinding
light and
see...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Someone's finally awake, huh? I was
waiting so
long that I can perfectly peel
off tape without
ripping it now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Gold Ship, who appears to be
wearing a
swimsuit. Why are we in this
tranquil field,
though? I frantically try to
clear my blurry mind
and remember how
we got here...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And this is Cursor Scroll! Wooo! ☆ Now,

Watermelon Slaaaash!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How do ya like my new summertime
dance
moves?! Deserves a hundred-page
report on how
inspired you are, I'd say!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come again? This isn't some boring

vacuum-sealed pack of tea leaves! I
really
expected more from you...
choice_data_list: Uhm... I think it's really great!
Uhm... I think it's really great!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look, that ant's making a food
delivery all
the way out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's when everything went dark, and
the next
thing I know, I wake up here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I gave the details of the operation using
the
learn-while-sleeping method. You're
clear on our
mission, right?
choice_data_list: (I remembered, but I still have no clue!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're taking it down today! The giant
squid spirit
that's holed up here may
have once ruled the
ancient seas, but its
time is over!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's up with you? Is your AI from last
century
or something? It's like you don't
understand one
darn thing.
choice_data_list: W-Why?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
See these creatures on me? The
seaweed, scallop,
crab, starfish, and
pearl? Look how brave they
are!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
These famous sages of the sea have
graced my
racewear with their awesome
power! It's
spectacular!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even now they whisper to me. The world
can't be
saved with ocean power alone.
We need to fill
ourselves with land
power too and hit the squid in
its lair.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then we follow their strategy to blast it
with a
beam of concentrated sunlight
and turn it into
dried squid! Doesn't that
get you pumped?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's it gonna be? You going home, or
do you
wanna come with me and live
forever?!
choice_data_list: ...H-Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Join me and they'll carve our valiant
figures into a
stone monument—and sell
key chains of us in
souvenir shops across
the country! Amazing,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, now we're talking! You shoulda
been
honest with me from the get-go,
you little rebel!
choice_data_list: ...I-I want to! I want to be etched into history!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, pick up that plankton blade.
But take it
easy... We're already in the
heart of the giant
squid's lair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel any presence, but apparently
it's here.
I take up my plankton blade
(stick) and wait for
the signal from Gold
Ship...
choice_data_list: There are squid already!?
There are squid already!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Raaaagh! Banish the evil spirit! Holy
Water
Ruuuush!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship unleashes a barrage of fire
from her
water gun as I start swinging
wildly until I can't
tell left from right
anymore. And then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the sky goes dark and the
ground
begins to quake. In the distance,
birds flee across
the sky and herds of
deer bound toward the
forest... What's
happening?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That tentacled menace... This just got
serious.
The squid's about to use its
super move!
choice_data_list: Wh-What's happening!?
Wh-What's going on!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Crap, this is bad. If we don't charge up
the pearl
with sun power, we can't finish
it off with an
ultimate Glassun Beam
blast!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There must be some light around
somewhere!
Please, light... come to
meeee!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Shine it on the pearl, quick!

Yeeeah! I can feel the poweeer!
choice_data_list: How about the flashlight on a phone?!
What about the flashlight on a phone?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I come to my senses, calm has
returned to
the area. We must have
defeated the giant squid!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We burned it right in the eyeballs!
This
pearl, you see, went on a
pilgrimage around the
world to become
a holy oyster and save all
sentient life!
choice_data_list: So that was Lady Pearl's power...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And we did it without using sunlight!
You came up
with an amazing idea!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hah! You really know what's up! Praise
them like
they deserve! Go on!
choice_data_list: Lady Wakame and the others had a great plan.
Lady Wakame and the others had a great plan, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haha! My racewear holds the all-stars of
the
seven seas!
choice_data_list: What a blessing, what a blessing...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haha! My racewear holds the all-stars of
the
seven seas!
choice_data_list: To think lights alone could pack that much power...
I bet your racewear got a power-up too.
Your racewear definitely got a power-up too, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, well, the power of the real thing
would've
knocked your socks off! A
sunbeam would've shot
straight back to
the sun itself!
choice_data_list: To think lights alone could pack that much power...
I bet your racewear got a power-up too.
Your racewear definitely got a power-up too, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, you don't even gotta say it! I bet
you're
dying to have a suit of your own,
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No prob, 'cause I'm having a giveaway
sale! I'll
put an order in next time I stick
my face in the
ocean! You're gonna love
it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the future is set. Soon I'll be
walking onto
the track with Gold Ship,
sporting the same
outfit... What have I
done?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Obviously! You're now looking at an
amphibious
superalloy super suit!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, we may have defeated the
giant squid,
but there's one last power
to charge up. After sea
and land comes...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bingo! You nailed it! I'll draw up a plan
soon,
cool? It's gonna blow you away!
choice_data_list: ...The sky?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open my eyes to find we're in the air... I
figured
this would happen, but I was too
caught up in the
moment to do anything
but agree.
